title: The Postcards of the old quarter
author: Petra Winterbourne
blurb: Ines Kavanagh, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
